## Progress

- Waiting on founder: launch market (default India), Azure subscription and region, AI model availability check

## Description

The founder decides the launch market (default: India first) and confirms the Azure subscription, billing owner and launch region (Central India or UAE North). Also confirm Azure OpenAI and AI Speech model availability in the chosen region (PRD risk "AI model not available in-region" says confirm in P0).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** ADR-002 is Accepted with the chosen market and the reasoning.
- [ ] **AC2.** Azure subscription ID, tenant, billing owner and launch region are recorded in docs/03-architecture/azure-deployment.md (no secrets).
- [ ] **AC3.** Microsoft for Startups (Founders Hub) credit application is submitted or explicitly declined.
- [ ] **AC4.** Availability of Azure OpenAI (chat model) and AI Speech (batch transcription + diarisation, languages en-IN/hi-IN/ta-IN or ar-AE) in the launch region is confirmed with a dated note.
- [ ] **AC5.** If UAE is chosen, PRD sequencing impact (EID reader and exchange on the critical path to week 29) is acknowledged in the ADR.
